products.title: BioNest — HSC Biology Question Bank
products.tagline: 12,000+ board & admission questions, sorted chapter-wise with instant answer keys.
products.description:
BioNest is the question bank I wished I had while teaching 200,000+ biology students.

Every question is tagged by chapter, board year and difficulty, so you can drill exactly what you are weak at instead of scrolling random PDFs. Answer keys are checked against the latest board syllabus, and each chapter ends with a 20-question self-test.

The pack includes a printable PDF, a Notion-ready copy and a spreadsheet tracker for revision.
features: 12,000+ MCQ + CQ questions with verified answers
Chapter-wise and year-wise filters (2015–2025)
Printable PDF + Notion copy + revision tracker
Lifetime access to every future update

products.title: RankRadar — SEO Audit Toolkit
products.tagline: Crawl any site, find the 20 fixes that actually move rankings, export a client-ready report.
products.description:
RankRadar is a lightweight desktop tool for quick technical SEO audits. Paste a URL, it crawls up to 500 pages and scores titles, meta descriptions, headings, alt text, internal links, page speed signals and duplicate content.

At the end you get a prioritised action list — the stuff worth fixing this week — plus a clean PDF report you can send to a client. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux (built with Electron).
features: Crawl up to 500 pages per audit
Prioritised fix list scored by impact
One-click branded PDF report export
Offline-first: your crawl data never leaves your machine

products.title: Admission War Room — Biology Crash Course
products.tagline: 8 weeks, 32 recorded lessons and a daily practice sheet to finish the admission syllabus on time.
products.description:
A battle-tested crash course for medical & university admission biology. Eight weeks, four lessons per week, each one 35–50 minutes and paired with a practice sheet.

Week 8 is a full mock-test marathon with worked solutions. You also get access to a private support group where I answer questions every week.
features: 32 recorded lessons (8 weeks, 18+ hours)
32 downloadable practice sheets + solutions
Two full mock exams with video walkthroughs
Private support group with weekly live Q&A

products.title: StudyPulse — Offline Notes Reader (APK)
products.tagline: Lightweight Android reader for PDFs and notes that keeps working with zero internet.
products.description:
StudyPulse is a 9 MB Android app for students who study on shared, low-end phones. It opens PDFs and text notes instantly, remembers the exact page you stopped on, and syncs nothing to the cloud unless you ask.

Includes a focus timer, night reading mode and a bookmark shelf. Built for Android 7 and above; no ads, no account, no tracking.
features: Only 9 MB — runs on low-end devices
Resumes your last page automatically
Dark mode + eye-comfort reading theme
No ads, no account, works fully offline

products.title: Somadhan — Worksheet Generator
products.tagline: Turn any chapter into a printable problem set with matched answer sheets in under a minute.
products.description:
Somadhan means solution — that's the whole idea. Pick a chapter from the built-in biology and chemistry map, choose how many questions and what difficulty, and it builds a clean printable worksheet plus an answer sheet.

It draws from a curated bank of 6,000+ items so students can't simply copy a friend's sheet. Great for tutors who run weekly tests.
features: 6,000+ curated questions with answer keys
Difficulty mixer from easy to olympiad level
Print-ready worksheet + answer sheet PDF
Unlimited generations for your own batches

products.title: Community Ops Kit
products.tagline: Templates, automations and SOPs for running a 10k+ member online education community.
products.description:
This is the operating system I used to run 30-person volunteer squads serving 200,000+ students. It is a folder of battle-tested assets, not theory.

Inside: onboarding flows, moderation SOPs, weekly content calendars, volunteer scorecards, and Google Sheets automations that post to Telegram on a schedule.
features: 18 ready-to-use SOPs and checklists
Notion community dashboard template
Google Sheets + Telegram automation recipes
Volunteer scorecard and retention tracker
